stem: A particle moving in a straight line covers half the distance with speed of 3 *m/s*. The other half of the distance is covered in two equal time intervals with speed of 4.5 *m/s* and 7.5 *m/s* respectively. The average speed of the particle during this motion is?

assets.alt: A line split into a first half of the distance at 3 m/s and a second half, which is divided into two equal times t at 4.5 m/s and 7.5 m/s.
